summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 results, including distributable earnings of $1.6 billion and over $1 billion in share repurchases year-to-date ($470M BN, $575M BAM). The release also announced plans to combine Brookfield Corporation (BN) with its insurance business (BNT) to streamline corporate structure and enhance capital efficiency. No specific merger terms, premium, or valuation were disclosed. The combination is presented as an internal restructuring rather than a market transaction with third-party consideration. The press release provides only preliminary intent details. Watch for future filings with definitive agreement terms and any required shareholder approvals.
